title: Biblical Wisdom
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Biblical wisdom is the God-given ability to walk rightly in decisions, speech, relationships, priorities, and daily conduct. Wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord and is shaped by His Word.
summary: Biblical wisdom is the God-given ability to walk rightly in decisions, speech, relationships, priorities, and daily conduct. Wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord and is shaped by His Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the wisdom of God, and in Him are hidden treasures of wisdom and knowledge. Believers grow in wisdom as they learn from Him, trust Him, and obey His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Wisdom is more than intelligence or information. A person may know many facts and still live foolishly. Biblical wisdom is truth applied to life under the fear of the Lord.

God invites His people to seek wisdom. He gives generously to those who ask in faith. Wisdom is found through Scripture, prayer, humility, correction, experience, and dependence on the Lord.

Wisdom affects ordinary decisions. It shapes speech, timing, relationships, work, money, conflict, temptation, and priorities. The wise life seeks to understand what is pleasing to the Lord.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many problems in life are not solved by knowledge alone. Believers need discernment, humility, timing, and obedience in complex situations.

This doctrine helps Christians move beyond impulsive decisions and worldly counsel. God’s wisdom is available, practical, and better than self-trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God for wisdom before you act, speak, decide, or respond. Search Scripture, seek godly counsel, fear the Lord more than people, and do not lean on your own understanding. Practice wisdom in small decisions as well as major ones.
